#!/usr/bin/env bash
# build-bridge.sh — compile RamusBridge for every loader, against real loader DLLs.
#
#   build-bridge.sh --out dist
#
# Exit code is the number of failed targets: the workflow job goes red if any
# compile fails. No target is ever reported as success on a skipped build.
set -euo pipefail

OUT="dist"
REFS=".ci/refs"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --out) OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --refs) REFS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,12p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

PROJ="runtime-probe/RamusBridge.csproj"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
declare -a PASSED=() FAILED=()

log()  { printf '[build] %s\n' "$*"; }
ok()   { PASSED+=("$1"); log "PASS  $1"; }
bad()  { FAILED+=("$1"); log "FAIL  $1"; }

# Flatten the loader assemblies into one folder, so the csproj can reference a
# single directory and never see the same assembly twice.
#
# The BepInEx IL2CPP zip also ships a private .NET runtime under dotnet/. Copying
# mscorlib/System.* out of it makes the compiler resolve predefined types from
# the 6.0 runtime instead of the targeting pack — CS0518 "System.Object is not
# defined", 291 errors. Those are dropped here.
flatten() {  # flatten <src-dir> <dst-dir>
  local src="$1" dst="$2"
  mkdir -p "$dst"
  find "$src" -type f -name '*.dll' \
       ! -path '*/dotnet/*' \
       ! -name 'mscorlib.dll' \
       ! -name 'netstandard.dll' \
       ! -name 'System.*.dll' \
       ! -name 'Microsoft.*.dll' \
       ! -name 'WindowsBase.dll' \
       ! -name 'Presentation*.dll' \
       -exec cp -n {} "$dst/" \; 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$dst" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.dll' | wc -l
}

# The Mono adapter inherits from MonoBehaviour, so the compiler needs a type
# identity for `UnityEngine, Version=0.0.0.0`. Build one stub assembly once and
# reference it; never ship it.
STUB_DIR="$PWD/$REFS/unity-stub"
build_unity_stub() {
  if [ -f "$STUB_DIR/UnityEngine.dll" ]; then return 0; fi
  log "building UnityEngine stub (identity 0.0.0.0)"
  rm -rf runtime-probe/BuildCheck/obj runtime-probe/BuildCheck/bin
  dotnet build runtime-probe/BuildCheck/UnityStubs.csproj -c Release -v minimal -nologo \
    "-p:OutDir=$STUB_DIR/" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /' || return 1
  [ -f "$STUB_DIR/UnityEngine.dll" ]
}

build() {  # build <label> <out-subdir> <extra msbuild args...>
  local label="$1" sub="$2"; shift 2
  rm -rf "runtime-probe/obj" "runtime-probe/bin"
  if dotnet build "$PROJ" -c Release -v minimal -nologo \
       "-p:OutDir=$PWD/$OUT/$sub/" "$@" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /'; then
    if ls "$OUT/$sub"/*.dll >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok "$label"; else bad "$label (no dll produced)"; fi
  else
    bad "$label"
  fi
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 0. Unity stub
if ! build_unity_stub; then
  bad "UnityEngine stub assembly (BuildCheck)"
fi

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 1. core (stubs)
log "core: syntax/type check against BuildCheck/UnityStubs.cs"
build "core (netstandard2.1, Unity stubs)" core \
  -p:Loader=Core -p:StubUnity=true -p:UnityStubDir="$STUB_DIR" -p:Tfm=netstandard2.1

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 2. BepInEx 6
BEP6="$REFS/bep6"
if [ -d "$BEP6" ] && [ "$(flatten "$BEP6" "$REFS/flat-bep6")" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "BepInEx 6 IL2CPP: $(ls "$REFS/flat-bep6" | wc -l) reference assemblies"
  build "BepInEx 6 IL2CPP (net6.0)" bepinex6 \
    -p:Loader=BepInEx6 -p:StubUnity=true -p:UnityStubDir="$STUB_DIR" -p:Tfm=net6.0 \
    -p:RefsDir="$PWD/$REFS/flat-bep6"
else
  bad "BepInEx 6 IL2CPP (reference zip missing)"
fi

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 3. MelonLoader
MELON="$REFS/melon"
if [ -d "$MELON" ] && [ "$(flatten "$MELON" "$REFS/flat-melon")" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "MelonLoader: $(ls "$REFS/flat-melon" | wc -l) reference assemblies"
  build "MelonLoader (net6.0)" melon \
    -p:Loader=MelonLoader -p:StubUnity=true -p:UnityStubDir="$STUB_DIR" -p:Tfm=net6.0 \
    -p:RefsDir="$PWD/$REFS/flat-melon"
else
  bad "MelonLoader (reference zip missing)"
fi

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 4. BepInEx 5
BEP5="$REFS/bep5"
if [ -d "$BEP5" ] && [ "$(flatten "$BEP5" "$REFS/flat-bep5")" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "BepInEx 5: $(ls "$REFS/flat-bep5" | wc -l) reference assemblies"
  build "BepInEx 5 (netstandard2.1)" bepinex5 \
    -p:Loader=BepInEx5 -p:StubUnity=true -p:UnityStubDir="$STUB_DIR" -p:Tfm=netstandard2.1 \
    -p:RefsDir="$PWD/$REFS/flat-bep5"
else
  bad "BepInEx 5 (reference zip missing)"
fi

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── 5. headless self-test (run)
# Compiles the same RamusBridge.cs against the stub and drives the HTTP server
# over a real socket. Needs the stub, so it is skipped if the stub failed.
if [ -f "$STUB_DIR/UnityEngine.dll" ]; then
  log "self-test: boot bridge on 127.0.0.1:18080 and call every endpoint"
  rm -rf runtime-probe/SelfTest/obj runtime-probe/SelfTest/bin
  if dotnet run --project runtime-probe/SelfTest/RamusBridge.SelfTest.csproj \
       -c Release -v quiet "-p:UnityStubDir=$STUB_DIR" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /'; then
    ok "self-test (HTTP + JSON + main-thread queue)"
  else
    bad "self-test (HTTP + JSON + main-thread queue)"
  fi
else
  bad "self-test (UnityEngine stub missing)"
fi

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── report
echo
echo "──────────────────────────────────────"
printf 'passed: %d\n' "${#PASSED[@]}"
for p in "${PASSED[@]:-}"; do [ -n "$p" ] && printf '  ✓ %s\n' "$p"; done
printf 'failed: %d\n' "${#FAILED[@]}"
for f in "${FAILED[@]:-}"; do [ -n "$f" ] && printf '  ✗ %s\n' "$f"; done
echo "──────────────────────────────────────"

if [ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]; then
  {
    echo "## Bridge build matrix"
    echo
    echo "| target | result |"
    echo "| --- | --- |"
    for p in "${PASSED[@]:-}"; do [ -n "$p" ] && echo "| $p | ✅ |"; done
    for f in "${FAILED[@]:-}"; do [ -n "$f" ] && echo "| $f | ❌ |"; done
  } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

[ "${#FAILED[@]}" -eq 0 ]

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# collect.sh — thu hết dữ liệu cần cho docs/spec, qua Ramus HAISCE qua adb local.
#
#   bash runtime-probe/collect.sh <apk>            # Ramus: tự bật phiên cloud
#   bash runtime-probe/collect.sh --local <package> # điện thoại đã nối adb sẵn
#
# Chế độ --local không gọi Ramus, không tốn quota: dùng đúng cách bạn đang chạy
# trên điện thoại (BepInEx + bridge mở cổng 8080, `adb forward`).
#
# Không hỏi lại. Sai ở đâu thì in "STOP:" rồi thoát.
# Mọi thứ ghi vào docs/apk-analysis/ramus/<ngày>/
set -uo pipefail

RUNNER=ramus
if [ "${1:-}" = "--local" ]; then
  RUNNER=local
  PKG=${2:-com.Wind.wings.Space.Shooter}
  shift 2 2>/dev/null || shift 1
else
  PKG=com.Wind.wings.Space.Shooter
fi

MOD_APK=${1:-}
if [ "$RUNNER" = ramus ]; then
  [ -n "$MOD_APK" ] || { echo "STOP: thiếu tham số APK. Dùng: bash runtime-probe/collect.sh <apk>"; exit 2; }
  [ -f "$MOD_APK" ] || { echo "STOP: không thấy file $MOD_APK"; exit 2; }
fi

RAMUS_CLI=${RAMUS_CLI:-ramus-cli@0.1.17}
OUT=${OUT:-docs/apk-analysis/ramus/$(date +%F)}
mkdir -p "$OUT"

say(){ printf '\n== %s ==\n' "$*"; }
die(){ echo "STOP: $*"; echo "Đã ghi những gì có vào $OUT — dán 40 dòng cuối cho người phụ trách."; exit 1; }
ram(){ npx --yes "$RAMUS_CLI" "$@"; }

# ── thiết bị: cùng một việc, hai đường ──────────────────────────────────────
dev_ready(){
  command -v adb >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "STOP: không có adb trong PATH"; exit 2; }
  SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{print $1; exit}')
  [ -n "$SERIAL" ] || { echo "STOP: adb không thấy thiết bị nào (adb devices rỗng)"; exit 2; }
  echo "$SERIAL" > "$OUT/serial.txt"
  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    || echo "CẢNH BÁO: $PKG không chạy — bật launcher + game trước, rồi chạy lại"
}
ui_snapshot(){ # $1 = file
  if [ "$RUNNER" = local ]; then
    adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out uiautomator dump /dev/tty 2>/dev/null > "$1" || true
  else
    ram snapshot --raw > "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  [ -s "$1" ]
}
shot(){ # $1 = file
  if [ "$RUNNER" = local ]; then
    adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out screencap -p > "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    ram screenshot --out "$1" --max-width 720 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
}
tap_xy(){ # $1 = "0.5,0.8" chuẩn hoá; $2 = rộng; $3 = cao
  local cx=${1%,*} cy=${1#*,}
  if [ "$RUNNER" = local ]; then
    adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap \
      "$(python3 -c "print(int(float('$cx')*$2))")" \
      "$(python3 -c "print(int(float('$cy')*$3))")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  else
    ram tap "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
  sleep 2
}
dev_logcat(){ # $1 = file
  if [ "$RUNNER" = local ]; then
    adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -b main -b crash -d > "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  elif [ -n "${SERIAL:-}" ]; then
    adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -b main -b crash -d > "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    ram logcat --limit 500 --filter "$PKG" > "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}

if [ "$RUNNER" = local ]; then
  say "1. thiết bị (adb local)"
  dev_ready
  echo "serial=$SERIAL  package=$PKG"
  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.cpu.abilist | tee "$OUT/device-abilist.txt" 2>&1 || true
  adb -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && echo "forward 8080 → thiết bị"
  echo "{\"runner\":\"local\",\"package\":\"$PKG\",\"serial\":\"$SERIAL\"}" > "$OUT/session.json"
  SID="(local:$SERIAL)"
  MODE=key
else
# ── 1. kiểm APK ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say "1. kiểm APK"
ls -l "$MOD_APK"
sha256sum "$MOD_APK" | tee "$OUT/apk-sha256.txt"
unzip -l "$MOD_APK" | grep -qiE "RamusBridge\.dll|BepInEx/|MelonLoader/" \
  || die "APK không có RamusBridge.dll và không có thư mục loader — đây không phải bản mod"

# ── 2. phiên ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say "2. bật phiên"
ram session start --apk "$MOD_APK" --wait --timeout 600 | tee "$OUT/session.json" \
  || die "session start thất bại"
SID=$(python3 - "$OUT/session.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
s=d.get("session")
print(s if isinstance(s,str) else (d.get("sessionId") or d.get("id") or d.get("session",{}).get("id") or ""))
PY
)
[ -n "$SID" ] || die "không đọc được session id từ session.json"
ram session status | tee "$OUT/session-status.json"
echo "session=$SID"
python3 - "$OUT/session.json" <<'PY'
import json,sys
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
if d.get("watchUrl"): print("WATCH (đưa cho user):", d["watchUrl"])
PY

# ── 3. tunnel (key mode) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
MODE=key
say "3. mở adb tunnel"
if out=$(ram adb --port 5555 2>&1); then
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | tee "$OUT/adb.txt"
  SERIAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -oE '(emulator-[0-9]+|[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}:[0-9]+)' | head -1)
  [ -n "$SERIAL" ] || SERIAL=$(adb devices 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device"{print $1; exit}')
  if [ -n "$SERIAL" ]; then
    echo "$SERIAL" > "$OUT/serial.txt"
    adb -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:8080 tcp:8080 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
else
  MODE=trial; echo "không có adb (trial) — chỉ lấy được logcat + ảnh"
fi
fi   # hết nhánh RUNNER=ramus

B=http://127.0.0.1:8080
wait_health(){ # $1 = giây
  local end=$(( $(date +%s) + $1 ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 5 "$B/health" -o "$OUT/health.json" 2>/dev/null; then return 0; fi
    sleep 5
  done
  return 1
}

if [ "$MODE" = key ]; then
  say "4. chờ bridge sống"
  wait_health 180 || die "không gọi được $B/health sau 180s"
  cat "$OUT/health.json"

  # Tên class thật. Run 23/10 gọi trượt vì đoán tên không có namespace
  # (SpaceShooter.EnemySystem.Enemy_Get_Datas); /types trả đúng tên để dùng lại.
  say "4b. liệt kê tên class"
  mkdir -p "$OUT/types"
  for q in Enemy_Get_Datas Percent Map_Get_Datas Stage_Get_Datas GP_Datas Tech Drone; do
    get "/types?filter=$q" "$OUT/types/$q.json"
  done
fi

# ── 4. dump ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TYPES="Player_Get_Datas Stage_Get_Datas Enemy_Get_Datas Map_Get_Datas Device_Get_Data
Enemy_Data_Balance Data_Players Data_Items Data_Boss DataShopPack IAPProduct GP_Datas
Tech_Ability_Data RankManager ArenaManager Box_Rewards Call_Data Wave Spawner"

get(){ curl -fsS --max-time 25 "$B$1" -o "$2" 2>/dev/null || echo "FAIL $1" >> "$OUT/failed.txt"; }

dump_moment(){ # $1 = menu | stage | ingame
  local L=$1
  say "dump [$L]"
  if [ "$MODE" = key ]; then
    for t in $TYPES; do
      mkdir -p "$OUT/statics-$L"
      get "/statics?type=$t&max=300&arr=256&depth=2" "$OUT/statics-$L/$t.json"
    done
    mkdir -p "$OUT/core-$L"
    get "/scene?max=300"               "$OUT/core-$L/scene.json"
    get "/hierarchy?depth=4&max=2000"  "$OUT/core-$L/hierarchy.json"
    get "/logs?n=300"                  "$OUT/core-$L/logs.json"
    get "/metrics"                     "$OUT/core-$L/metrics.json"
    for o in Player_Ingame Player_Health Enemy_Sub Enemy_Hp_Bar Stage_Behaviour MapController Gun_Attack; do
      mkdir -p "$OUT/find"; get "/find?name=$o&max=20" "$OUT/find/$L-$o.json"
    done
    # What is actually playing right now. Without this, every animation claim is
    # an inference from asset names (docs/spec/ANIMATION_GAPS.md §2e).
    get "/anim?max=60" "$OUT/anim-$L.json"
  fi
  ui_snapshot "$OUT/ui-$L.xml" || echo "FAIL snapshot $L" >> "$OUT/failed.txt"
  shot "$OUT/screen-$L.jpg"
  dev_logcat "$OUT/logcat-$L.txt"
}

# Bấm vào phần tử có text khớp. Không khớp thì in danh sách text và dừng — không đoán.
tap_text(){ # $1 = xml, $2.. = regex
  local xml=$1; shift
  # python trả về "W H cx cy" (cx/cy chuẩn hoá 0..1) để dùng được cho cả hai runner.
  local info
  info=$(python3 - "$xml" "$@" <<'PY'
import re,sys
xml=open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore').read()
pats=[re.compile(p,re.I) for p in sys.argv[2:]]
m=re.search(r'bounds="\[0,0\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"',xml)
if not m: sys.exit(1)
W,H=int(m.group(1)),int(m.group(2))
nodes=re.findall(r'<node[^>]*text="([^"]*)"[^>]*bounds="\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"',xml)
if not nodes:
    nodes=[(b,d,e,f,g) for a,b,c,d,e,f,g in re.findall(r'<node[^>]*text="([^"]*)"([^>]*)bounds="\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]"',xml)]
for text,x1,y1,x2,y2 in nodes:
    if not text.strip(): continue
    if any(p.search(text) for p in pats):
        cx=(int(x1)+int(x2))/2/W; cy=(int(y1)+int(y2))/2/H
        print(f"{W} {H} {cx:.4f} {cy:.4f}"); print(text[:60],file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)
PY
)
  [ -n "$info" ] || return 1
  set -- $info
  echo "tap $3,$4"
  tap_xy "$3,$4" "$1" "$2"
}

# ── 5. đi qua menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say "5. dọn hộp thoại hệ thống"

  adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p "$PKG" -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
else

dump_moment menu

  fi
  if [ "$MODE" = key ] && curl -fsS --max-time 8 "$B/health" 2>/dev/null | grep -qi 'ingame'; then

  fi
  # stage/mode: bấm ô stage đầu tiên nếu thấy chữ stage
  if tap_text "$OUT/ui-step.xml" '^stage 1$|^1-1$|^stage$|^play$|^select$'; then sleep 4; continue; fi
  break
done
sleep 6
dump_moment stage || true
[ "$entered" -eq 1 ] && echo "đã vào scene chơi" || echo "chưa xác nhận được scene chơi — vẫn dump tiếp"

if [ "$MODE" = key ]; then
  say "7. đóng băng rồi dump trong màn"

  curl -fsS -X POST "$B/timescale?v=1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

# ── 6. kiểm đủ ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
say "8. kiểm tra đầy đủ"
python3 - "$OUT" "$MODE" <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,sys
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); mode=sys.argv[2]
need={"P0 statics":["statics-ingame/Player_Get_Datas.json","statics-ingame/Stage_Get_Datas.json",
                    "statics-ingame/Enemy_Get_Datas.json","statics-ingame/Map_Get_Datas.json",
                    "statics-ingame/Device_Get_Data.json","statics-ingame/Enemy_Data_Balance.json"],
      "ten class":["types/Percent.json","types/Enemy_Get_Datas.json"],
  "playback":["anim-ingame.json"],
      "P0 runtime":["find/ingame-Player_Health.json","find/ingame-Enemy_Sub.json"],
      "màn hình":["screen-menu.jpg","screen-stage.jpg","screen-ingame.jpg"],
      "log":["logcat-final.txt"] if (pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/"logcat-final.txt").exists() else ["logcat-ingame.txt"],
      "handle":["session.json"]}
bad=[]
for g,fs in need.items():
    for f in fs:
        p=out/f
        if not (p.exists() and p.stat().st_size>20): bad.append(f"[{g}] {f}")
if mode=="trial":
    print("MODE=trial: không có adb ⇒ KHÔNG lấy được số từ /statics. Chỉ có ảnh + logcat.")
    print("ĐÂY KHÔNG PHẢI LỖI CỦA SCRIPT — cần key mode để có số liệu.")
else:
    print("\nĐỦ" if not bad else "THIẾU:\n  "+"\n  ".join(bad))
PY

say "xong"
echo "session giữ nguyên: $SID"
